method: the journal's own pages read by hand on 2026-11-07 (the home page, /articles, /issues, /search, /for-authors/, /special-collections/, /editorial-board/, /policies/ and /about/); each feature marked against Verse's page (/journal/) by the words that page carries, so a builder can check the mark on the live page. The page is the one of PR #2521 (the papers read live, the search, the saved list) with the author's half added: the guidelines, the board, the policies and the publication-unit calculator.

features.name: The newest papers with their abstracts
features.detail: a heading on / (Latest Research)
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "Latest" and the abstract of each paper

features.name: The authors of each paper
features.detail: a line under each title on /
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ names the authors of a paper found by the search; the newest papers come from the journal's own feed, which names no author

features.name: The volume each paper is in
features.detail: a line under each title on /
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows the volume of a paper found by the search; the feed carries no volume

features.name: The DOI of each paper
features.detail: on every article page
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows the DOI of each paper, linking to it

features.name: Search articles
features.detail: a heading on /search
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "Search" over the public research record

features.name: A saved list of papers
features.detail: kept on the reader's device
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "Saved papers (this device)"

features.name: Browse by volume and issue
features.detail: a heading on /issues
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ does not list the volumes yet

features.name: Special collections by theme
features.detail: a heading on /special-collections/
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ has no collections yet

features.name: The PDF of each paper
features.detail: a download on every article page

features.name: The reference list of each paper
features.detail: on every article page
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ does not show a paper's references

features.name: The author guidelines
features.detail: a heading on /for-authors/ (scope, submission checklist, publication options, evaluation criteria, the manuscript order, equations, tables, figures, citations, statistics)
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "For authors", "Before you submit", "Science Paper", "order of a manuscript", "APA" and "standard error"

features.name: The length of a paper in publication units, with the fee
features.detail: a heading on /for-authors/ (Paper Length): 1 PU per 500 words, 1.5 PU per figure or table, $100 per excess PU
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "publication units" and works them out on the device, with the working shown

features.name: The editorial board and the advisory board
features.detail: a heading on /editorial-board/
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows the editors, the associate editors and the advisory board with their fields

features.name: Copyright and permissions, peer review and publication ethics
features.detail: a heading on /policies/
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "Peer review", "Publication ethics" and "Copyright and permissions"

features.name: No publication charges within the standard limits
features.detail: a heading on / (Diamond Open Access since 2023)
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows "diamond open access"

features.name: Submit a manuscript
features.detail: a button on every page, into the journal's submission system
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows what a submission must have, but never sends one

features.name: Contact the editorial office
features.detail: a link on every page (the editorial office's published address, [email]) privacy:ok: a published business contact, on the journal's own pages
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows the editorial office's address

features.name: About the journal and its scope
features.detail: a heading on /about/ (founded in 1818, the oldest continuously published scientific journal in the United States)
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ shows the scope of the journal, not its history

features.name: An RSS feed of the newest papers
features.detail: a link in the footer of every page
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ reads the journal's feed but publishes none of its own

features.name: Links to the journal on other sites
features.detail: a link in the footer of every page (Facebook, X)
features.verse_evidence: /journal/ links to no other site
